test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following schemes was launched in year 2006?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• In 2005, India introduced a** national anti-poverty program**, now called the** Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme.**
 
• This scheme **offered up to 100 days of unskilled manual labour per year on public works projects**.
 
• **It guarantees 100 days of wage employment in the financial year to a rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work**.
 
• The NREGA will be relevant to areas notified by the Central Government and will cover the whole country within five years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana is **a Government of India scheme, which enables a small borrower to borrow from banks, MFIs, and NBFCs for loans up to 10 lakh for non-farm income generating activities**. 
 
• **Pradhan Mantri Jan-Dhan Yojana **is the National goal for Financial Inclusion to secure access to financial services, namely, basic savings & deposit accounts, remittance, credit, insurance, and pension in an affordable manner.​ 
 
• Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is **a Government-backed Life insurance scheme in India**.
